`pickLocale` splits the `Accept-Language` header by commas and returns the first supported language it encounters, completely ignoring any `q` quality weights. We should update `pickLocale` in `src/i18n/index.ts` to parse `q=` quality values from the `Accept-Language` header and select the supported language with the highest weight instead of the first listed language.
